posts.name: TheBazaarClerk
posts.cooked:
This was a lovely episode (pun semi-intended). With the games being so combat centric its nice getting to know more about our heroes personal lives, and there were plenty of sweet/bittersweet moments through it. I even felt sad for Biomancer. 

It'd be cool to get another episode like this, but I don't know any episode similar theme that would be as interesting ("Hobbies of the multiverse" perharps?). 

 

This is also one of those episodes where I have to read the notes on reddit so I can remember all the confirmed/unconfirmed ships, specially for the bit on Knyfe's list of... encounters. 

 

I believe the Ra/Fanatic section was the most explicit C&A ever got in the podcast... Not the "touching butts" but that they non-euphemistically referred to sex.

 

Nightmist and Gladys dialogue was one of my favorite parts, not only because of it was funny as hell (once again I was laughing loudly in public), but that's the perfect reaction to villains-trying-to-be-seductive-out-of-nowhere thing. 

 

> (And now all I can think of is KNYFE just wrecking Chrono-Ranger and then getting wrecked in turn by Haka, like how, he must have phenomenal control.)  

I have theories:

-Not only Haka absorbs the strenght and vitality of his alternate dimensions, but also their mojo ;)

-She was wearing the mecha-suit. 

 

...Aaaaaand that's all I'm going to say about the characters sexual lives.
